_doc: Long-text KB benchmark manifest for local scheduler retrieval using airplane-manual-collection. Do not use these manuals for operational flight decisions.

source.safety_note: The upstream README warns that manuals may not be verified for real-life use. This dataset is for retrieval benchmarking only.

smoke.purpose: fast ingestion and partition-routing sanity check

local_scheduler_30b.purpose: local scheduler RAG with SRAS/context-admission budget

local_scheduler_comprehensive.purpose: thousands-page local vector DB test across major aircraft/manual types

stress.purpose: long-context decay and mixed-vendor retrieval pressure

expected_surface: indexed document visible in Items view
chat input accepts long-text KB query
local scheduler status is rendered when local scheduler path is used
